ordo-virtutum-hildegard.description: A veiled woman in a black habit and white wimple, with a cross on her chest, stands in a dim stone chapel with arched bays and a fresco. She raises one hand toward a row of nuns holding a book and singing under candlelight. A horned, clawed devil crouches in the shadows at the right edge.

machaut-messe-de-nostre-dame.description: Five men in dark robes, some with fur collars and some in monk-like hoods, sing around a large open book of music on a dark wooden lectern. Two tall lit candles stand on brass holders beside the book, and a third candle is behind it. The setting is a stone interior with pointed Gothic arches, ribbed vaulting and tall columns fading into shadow. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text or frame.

dufay-nuper-rosarum-flores.description: A large brick-red domed cathedral with white and green marble facing, seen from an elevated angle over a city of terracotta rooftops and distant hills. In the square below, a procession of clergy in gold, white and red vestments moves toward the central doorway through a crowd of people in long dark and muted period robes. Red petals drift through the air. No visible text, frame or border.

palestrina-pope-marcellus-mass.description: A painted stone interior with rounded arches and wall frescoes. A choir of boys and men in white surplices sings from a marble balustrade gallery, and one man holds up a large open book. In the lower right foreground an elderly man in a red cardinal's cape and red skullcap sits on a wooden bench, chin in hand, listening, with more red-robed clerics seated behind him. Candles burn on wall sconces and light comes through high windows.

bach-brandenburg-concertos.description: A candlelit panelled room with a man in a powdered wig and embroidered dark coat playing a large ornate harpsichord with a painted lid. Behind him, a violinist, a cellist and another violinist play. Framed portraits hang on the wooden walls, and a curtain is at the upper left. The image fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

haydn-creation-oratorio.description: An elderly man with white hair and a black ribbon queue, in a dark coat with white cuffs, raises one arm and holds a rolled sheet of paper aloft. He faces a large candlelit hall with gilt ceiling paintings and crystal chandeliers, where an orchestra of strings, horns and a harpsichord plays and a chorus of men and women in 18th-century dress sings from music stands. A shaft of light falls through a high window onto the scene.

berlioz-symphonie-fantastique.description: A dark-haired young man in a white shirt and dark waistcoat lies slumped and asleep in a red velvet armchair beside a table with a lit candle, a small bottle of red liquid and scattered papers. Above him a pale ghostly woman in a long white gown drifts through swirling smoke, and behind her dark horned and winged figures and dancing wraiths fill a shadowy, painterly background. Oil-painting style, edge to edge, no visible text or frame.

mendelssohn-wedding-march.description: A dim forest scene with tall trees and misty light. Winged fairies in pale gauzy dresses and flower crowns stand around a bride in a white veil and gown and a groom in a dark tailcoat. Below, in the foreground, a conductor with a baton faces a seated orchestra with violins, a tuba and candlelit music stands, and lanterns glow in the fog.

strauss-blue-danube-waltz.description: A grand ballroom with crystal chandeliers and gilt-trimmed arches. A couple in a navy and cream lace gown and a black tailcoat waltzes in the foreground, with other dancing couples behind them. On the right a violinist in tails conducts a seated orchestra from a raised platform lit by candles, and balcony spectators look on. Mid-19th-century dress and furnishings, painted in a loose oil style.

chopin-24-preludes-published.description: A man with shoulder-length dark wavy hair in a dark long coat sits hunched over an upright piano, playing with both hands while looking down at the keys. A lit candle stands on the piano top beside a stack of papers, and sheet music is open on the stand and lying on the keyboard lid. Behind him an arched stone-walled room has a window showing rain streaking across a dark street and foliage, and he sits on a rush-seat wooden chair. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text beyond an illegible maker's mark on the piano.

wagner-ring-cycle-bayreuth.description: A woman in a winged helmet and chainmail, cape billowing, raises a spear while standing on a rock outcrop with a round patterned shield. Behind her, dark silhouettes of helmeted figures with spears rise out of smoke under a red-orange stormy sky. Wooden stage scaffolding frames both sides, and at the bottom an orchestra pit is lit by candles, with musicians and a conductor in silhouette. No visible text, border or frame; the scene fills the canvas edge to edge.

bizet-carmen-premiere.description: A man in a dark blue military-style uniform with red epaulettes and red trouser stripe holds a cap and faces a woman with long dark hair, a red flower in it, in a black bodice and layered red-and-black ruffled skirt, hands on hips. They stand in a sunlit plaza with colonnaded pale buildings, with a uniformed figure at the right edge and onlookers in the background. The painting is loose oil-style brushwork, filling the whole frame, with no visible text.

puccini-la-boheme-premiere.description: A dim, cluttered attic with a kneeling man in a brown overcoat holding the hand of a woman in a dark dress seated in an upholstered armchair. A lit iron stove glows at right, and a moonlit skylight with flecks of falling white lets light down through the dark. Stage flats and a backdrop are visible at left, with a top hat on the wall, scattered papers on the floor, and framed canvases leaning against the wall. No visible text. The painting fills the frame edge to edge. Era reads as late 19th century.

rachmaninoff-piano-concerto-2.description: A pianist in a dark suit, seen from behind, plays a black grand piano with its lid raised. Behind it an orchestra with violins and a conductor with one arm raised fills an ornate gilded concert hall. Balconies above hold a crowd, and a chandelier hangs from the vaulted ceiling. Warm, dim lamplight and painterly brushwork; no visible text, border or gore.

debussy-clair-de-lune.description: A dark, painterly parlour interior with a glossy black grand piano, lid raised, and an open music book on the stand. Tall arched windows stand open onto a moonlit garden and a still pond reflecting a full moon. Damask wallpaper, drapes, a patterned rug and a gilt mirror edge at the right are part of the room. No people. A tiny illegible gilt maker's mark sits on the piano fallboard. The painting fills the image edge to edge.

ravel-bolero-premiere.description: A woman in a ruffled, flamenco-style dress dances with her arms raised on a round wooden table in a dim tavern, lit by a single hanging lamp. Men in flat caps and dark suits sit and stand around the table, watching, with smoke drifting in the air. A snare drum with two sticks rests in the foreground on the table. Wooden balconies and a staircase are visible in the background. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.

prokofiev-peter-and-the-wolf.description: A winter forest scene in an oil-painting style. A child in a fur-trimmed cap, brown coat and red scarf holds a coiled rope on snowy ground among birch trees. A black wolf stands at the right edge among snowy pines. A mallard duck swims on partly frozen water at lower left, and a small songbird perches on a branch at left. A wooden flute lies on a branch at upper left, and two bassoon-like woodwinds lie in the snow at right and lower centre. No text, no frame.

orff-carmina-burana-premiere.description: A dark, painterly scene of a huge wooden wheel with a crowned figure at its top and small figures clinging to its rim or tumbling from it. Below, rows of hooded, robed singers hold open books in front of a central hooded figure, with cellos at the left and a trombone at the right. Smoke drifts through the lower half, and there is no visible text or border.

britten-war-requiem-premiere.description: A dark painterly scene of a tall, blackened cross standing on a rubble plinth. To its left is a roofless Gothic stone church with pointed-arch tracery windows, and to its right a modern glass-curtain-wall building with warm interior lights. Debris lies in the foreground under a grey stormy sky. There is no visible text, frame or figure.

glass-einstein-on-the-beach.description: A dark, murky painting of a black steam locomotive standing in a dim shed, with a glowing white fluorescent tube overhead and wisps of steam. In the foreground a small wooden chair sits on a dark floor, lit from above, with a violin leaning against its back. No people are visible, and there is no visible text, frame or border.

adams-nixon-in-china-premiere.description: A silver twin-engine passenger jet with a white-grey fuselage sits on a dark stage-like set under spotlights, on a grey tarmac strip with white centre markings. Red flags on poles line both sides of the stage, and dark wooden wings and a low step frame the scene. No people, no visible text.
